newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-Straddle sold in Ladbroke ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-Straddle sold in Ladbroke ahead of results.

text.p: UK equity traded options business was light on Monday as many underlying stocks were softer and the main deals by mid-afternoon were from sellers hoping to collect option premiums, dealers said.

Over in hotels-to-leisure company Ladbroke Group, a short straddle was the main deal and it involved selling 250 August 240 puts and calls at 4-1/2p and 5-1/2p each ahead of the group's half year results, due on August 28.
The options expire on August 20 and if the shares stay flat, finishing at 240p by that date, the straddle seller will make a maximum 10p profit.
By 1400 GMT, Ladbroke shares were up 3p to 245p.
The biggest deal in autocomponents manufacturer LucasVarity was from a seller of 500 August 200 calls at 3p.

Elsewhere, banking and financial services group HSBC Holdings attracted a flurry of small trades, after the group announced pre-tax profits were up 13 percent to 2.623 billion stg and the dividend shot up 33 percent to 20p per share.
Analysts had forecast pre-tax profits of between 2.32 and 2.48 billion stg.
HSBC shares went up 50-1/2p to 2249-1/2p having traded as high as 2326p.
